title: Unsupported link
text: I just got a notification from the Claude Code app that says unsupported link.

keys: Is this a bug in Claude Code app
Check if link format is one app doesn't support
Find which link triggered the 'unsupported link' notification
Identify the sender: push notification, card, or agent message
Check link format: localhost/IP links unsupported in the mobile app
Fix links to a format the app supports
Tell the owner in plain words what caused it
Prevent recurrence: update the link-hosts rule or the notifier
Verify the corrected notification opens properly
